Splitting the 18-conformer Ag complex ensemble into one folder per conformer, and merging two small
XYZ files back into one.

**Files used** (from the repository):

* `files/ensemble.xyz` — 18 conformers of an Ag complex, 168 atoms (comment line = energy)
* `files/multi_NP.xyz` — one 4-atom test structure
* `files/multi_PN.xyz` — one 4-atom test structure

**1. Split.**

```bash
frog-split files/ensemble.xyz
```

```text
ℹ  Splitting 18 structures from files/ensemble.xyz into files/ensemble_split
✔  Saved structure: files/ensemble_split/conf_1/geom.xyz
✔  Saved structure: files/ensemble_split/conf_2/geom.xyz
✔  Saved structure: files/ensemble_split/conf_3/geom.xyz
✔  Saved structure: files/ensemble_split/conf_4/geom.xyz
✔  Saved structure: files/ensemble_split/conf_5/geom.xyz
…
```

`files/ensemble_split/conf_1/geom.xyz` (first 3 lines):

```text
168
-257.40634594
Ag    -0.045590    -0.784564    -0.218938
…
```

18 folders `conf_1` … `conf_18` are written to `files/ensemble_split/` (only the first lines are
shown). Numbering starts at 1. Each `geom.xyz` keeps the original comment line, here the energy
−257.40634594 of the first conformer. Run it again and the existing folders are skipped; add `-f`
to overwrite them.

**2. Merge.**

```bash
frog-split --merge files/multi_PN.xyz files/multi_NP.xyz -o merged.xyz
```

```text
ℹ  Merging 2 structures from 2 files
✔  Saved merged ensemble (2 structures): merged.xyz
```

`merged.xyz`:

```text
4
Comment 1
 H     0.000000     0.000000     0.000000
 H     0.000000     0.000000     1.000000
 O     1.000000     2.000000     0.000000
 F     0.000000     1.000000     2.000000
4
Comment 2
 H     0.000000     0.000000     0.000000
 H     0.000000     0.000000     1.000000
 O     1.000000     2.000000     0.000000
 F     0.000000    -1.000000    -2.000000
```

The 2 structures are concatenated in the order of the command line, with their own comment lines.
